scope: Native Q2 face adjacency in all eight radial-work bands of the steady held cubic carrier at prescribed reference intake. Same-density neutral pressure check for the bare order law. No estimate of backing traction on a draining wall.
instrument:
"""Count traces of the stored carrier at side-wall faces used for radial work."""
import json
import sys
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

import numpy as np
import sympy as sp

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path('software/stage1_solver/tools').resolve()))
from mouth_carrier_lateral_response import prepare
from mouth_deep_attachment_traction import BANDS
from mouth_flared_receiver import EXIT

def emit(**row):
    print(json.dumps(row,allow_nan=False),flush=True)


def main():
    src = Path('_scratch/s11c/mouth_flared_cubic_n34')
    dom, field = prepare(SimpleNamespace(source=src))
    owners = defaultdict(list)
    for block, (_, _, dofs) in dom.blocks.items():
        for el in dofs.reshape(-1,3,3):
            for edge in (el[0,:],el[-1,:],el[:,0],el[:,-1]):
                owners[tuple(sorted(edge))].append(block)
    p, v, ids = dom.blocks[2]
    cells = ids.reshape(len(p)-1,len(v)-1,3,3)
    outer_faces = cells[:,0,:,0]
    side_counts = []
    for lo, hi in BANDS:
        # Include every side face intersecting the open depth band.
        sel = (p[1:]>lo+1e-12)&(p[:-1]<hi-1e-12)
        block_owners = [owners[tuple(sorted(e))] for e in outer_faces[sel]]
        side_counts.append([len(o) for o in block_owners])
        emit(test='sidewall',band=[lo,hi],incident_blocks=block_owners)
    exit_owners = [owners[tuple(sorted(e))] for e in cells[-1,:,-1,:]]
    emit(test='through_exit',w=EXIT,receiving_chamber_starts=[float(dom.blocks[i][0][0]) for i in (3,4)],
         number_of_faces=len(exit_owners),incident_blocks=sorted({tuple(sorted(x)) for x in exit_owners}))
    if not all(len(x)>0 and all(c==1 for c in x) for x in side_counts):
        raise ArithmeticError('Unexpected side-wall adjacency')
    if not all(sorted(v)==[2,3] for v in exit_owners):
        raise ArithmeticError('Expected two traces at through-going exit')
    bulk = sp.Function('U')
    n,chi,a=sp.symbols('n chi a',positive=True)
    free=bulk(n)+a*chi**2*(1-chi)**2
    p=n*free.diff(n)-free
    diff=sp.simplify(p.subs(chi,1)-p.subs(chi,0))
    emit(test='homogeneous_unstrained_order',assumptions='same n, common U(n), no order gradients, wave, f_mix or throat energy', pressure_ordered=str(p.subs(chi,1)),pressure_disordered=str(p.subs(chi,0)),delta_pressure=str(diff))
    if diff!=0:
        raise ArithmeticError('Bare endpoint pressures differ')

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
